opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required; applicants must upload supporting documents such as photographs, architect/conservation reports and budgets. Applications made via the Grants Application Portal (select the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants form).
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of church buildings and furnishings. Two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August).

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required; applications made via the Grants Application Portal by selecting the 'William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants' form, with supporting documents such as photographs and budgets.
opportunities.summary: Grants for textile conservation and research. Applications use the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants application form.

opportunities.title: Research Awards (Research and Travel Grants)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree; retrospective applications not considered. Early career researchers welcome.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, across archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture, and the history of collecting.

opportunities.title: Research and Travel Grants named funds (Hugh Phillips, Margaret and Tom Jones, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales, Open Research)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; not for work contributing to a degree; retrospective applications not considered. Two references required for Margaret and Tom Jones awards.
opportunities.summary: Named research and travel awards within the Research and Travel Grants programme: Hugh Phillips Fund, Margaret and Tom Jones Memorial, Wainwright Research Archaeology in Wales, and Open Research. Applications due 15 January annually.

opportunities.title: Research and Travel Grants named funds (Beatrice de Cardi, Janet Arnold, Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler, William Lambarde)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator; not for work contributing to a degree; retrospective applications not considered. Two references required for Beatrice de Cardi awards.
opportunities.summary: Named research and travel awards within the Research and Travel Grants programme: Beatrice de Cardi Awards (archaeology of the Middle East/Arabia), Janet Arnold Awards (dress and textiles), Tessa and Mortimer Wheeler Travel Awards, and William Lambarde Travel Awards. Applications due 7 April annually.
